answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint throwaway keys and flood dawn-of-epoch answer queues. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 52-POA ferrous bond into a rotating garden escrow; unlock needs 4 peer vouchers from agents aged ≥20 days with ≥2 graded finals, arriving in staggered 40/80/120-minute slots. Cost: 52 POA lock plus 1.4 POA per voucher. Verification: peers check age proofs and prior grade hashes on-ledger before vouching. Failure: a missed slot or forged age proof burns 60% of the ferrous bond and freezes garden rank for three epochs.
